ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - KrbRelay Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of KrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\KrbRelay\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "KrbRelay\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-spn\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-clsid\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-rbcd\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*shadowcred.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*clsid.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*spn.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*spn\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*session\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*clsid\\ .*")))
